'''Yanic Konan Niederhäuser''' (born 14 March 2003) is a Swiss professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Northern Illinois Huskies men's basketball|Northern Illinois Huskies]] and [[Penn State Nittany Lions basketball|Penn State Nittany Lions]].

==Early life and high school career==
Niederhäuser was born in [[Bern]], Switzerland, to a German-speaking father and a mother of Ivorian descent.<ref name=bn>{{cite web |title=Yanic Konan Niederhäuser on his way to the NBA |url=https://www.bluewin.ch/en/sport/yanic-konan-niederhaeuser-on-his-way-to-the-nba-2748374.html |website=blue News |access-date=12 July 2025 |date=20 June 2025}}</ref> His middle name, Konan, was chosen by his father after the titular character played by [[Arnold Schwarzenegger]] in the film ''[[Conan the Barbarian (1982 film)|Conan the Barbarian]]''; Niederhäuser includes his middle name on his jersey.<ref name=bn/> Niederhäuser was raised in [[Fräschels]] and started playing basketball at the age of 10 in [[Neuchâtel]].<ref name=bn/>

During the 2021–22 season, Niederhäuser played for [[Ehingen Urspring]], a professional German club, on both its youth team and its German Pro A League squad.<ref>{{cite news|title=Yanic Konan Niederhäuser Ehingen Urspring statistics|url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/239906/yanic-niederhauser/games/2021|work=Proballers.com|access-date=9 April 2022}}</ref> After the season, he committed to play [[college basketball]] in the United States for the [[Northern Illinois Huskies men's basketball|Northern Illinois Huskies]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Valladares |first=Brennan |date=3 November 2024 |title=Yanic Konan Niederhäuser is a Jump Shot Away from Being the Perfect Center Piece for Penn State |url=https://nittanysportsnow.com/2024/11/yanic-konan-niederhauser-penn-state/ |access-date=15 May 2025 |website=Nittany Sports Now}}</ref>

==College career==
===Northern Illinois===
As a [[freshman]] in 2022–23, Niederhäuser played in 20 games with two starts, averaging 2.2 points and 1.5 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite web |title=Yanic Konan Niederhauser 2022-23 Game Log |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/yanic-konan-niederhauser-1/gamelog/2023 |website=Sports Reference |access-date=15 May 2025}}</ref> During the 2023–24 season, he made 26 starts, averaging 7.3 points and 4.4 rebounds per game.<ref name="Max Ralph">{{cite web |last=Ralph |first=Max |date=1 August 2024 |title=Penn State 7-footer Yanic Konan Niederhauser one to watch as Lions wrap up summer: basketball notes |url=https://www.pennlive.com/penn-state-mens-basketball/2024/08/penn-state-7-footer-yanic-konan-niederhauser-one-to-watch-as-lions-wrap-up-summer-basketball-notes.html |access-date=15 May 2025 |website=PennLive.com}}</ref> After the 2023–24 season, Niederhäuser entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Wogenrich |first=Mark |date=16 April 2024 |title=Penn State Basketball Lands Shot-Blocking Forward From Transfer Portal |url=https://www.si.com/college/pennstate/news/penn-state-basketball-nittany-lions-transfer-yanic-konan-niederhauser-ncaa-transfer-portal |access-date=15 May 2025 |publisher=SI.com}}</ref>

==Professional career==
On 25 June 2025, Niederhäuser was selected last in the first round, with the 30th pick by the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] in the [[2025 NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 June 2025 |title=LA Clippers Select Yanic Konan Niederhäuser with 30th Overall Pick in 2025 NBA Draft |url=https://www.nba.com/clippers/news/la-clippers-select-yanic-konan-niederhauser-with-30th-overall-pick-in-2025-nba-draft |access-date=18 July 2025 |website=NBA.com}}</ref> He made 41 appearances for Los Angeles during his rookie campaign, averaging 4.3 points, 2.9 rebounds, and 0.3 assists. On 6 March 2026, it was announced that Niederhauser would require season-ending surgery to repair a [[Lisfranc injury]] in his right foot.<ref>{{cite web |title=Yanic Konan Niederhauser is out with a season-ending foot injury |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/nba-news/1939907/yanic-konan-niederhauser-season-ending-injury-los-angeles-clippers-nba/ |website=Eurohoops |access-date=6 March 2026 |language=en |date=6 March 2026}}</ref>

==National team career==
Niederhäuser first represented Switzerland at the youth level during the [[2021 FIBA U18 European Challengers]] competition. He averaged 10.3 points, 7.7 rebounds and 2.7 blocks per game by the end of the tournament.<ref>{{cite news |title=Yanic Konan Niederhäuser 2021 FIBA U18 European Challengers profile |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/264-fiba-u18-european-challengers/208419/players/248664-yanic-konan-niederhauser |access-date=8 August 2021 |work=fiba.basketball}}</ref> In 2022, with the U20 national team at the [[2022 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B]], he averaged 6.6 points, 4.3 rebounds and 1.7 blocks during the event.<ref>{{cite news |title=Yanic Konan Niederhäuser 2022 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B profile |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/280-fiba-u20-eurobasket-division-b/208472/players/248664-yanic-konan-niederhauser |access-date=24 July 2022 |work=fiba.basketball}}</ref> In July 2023, Niederhäuser returned to the U20 national team for the [[2023 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B]]. He finished with averages of 7.7 points, 4.4 rebounds and two blocks per game.<ref>{{cite news |title=Yanic Konan Niederhäuser 2023 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B profile |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/280-fiba-u20-eurobasket-division-b/208579/players/248664-yanic-niederhauser |access-date=16 July 2023 |work=fiba.basketball}}</ref>

Following Niederhäuser's stint at the youth level in July 2023, he was named to the senior [[Switzerland men's national basketball team|Switzerland national team]] later that month, for the third round of [[EuroBasket 2025 qualification|EuroBasket 2025 pre-qualifiers]]. In his two games against [[Kosovo men's national basketball team|Kosovo]] and [[Denmark men's national basketball team|Denmark]], he averaged 11.5 points, three rebounds and two blocks per game.<ref>{{cite news |title=Yanic Konan Niederhäuser EuroBasket 2025 Pre-Qualifiers profile |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/204-fiba-eurobasket-pre-qualifiers/208437/players/248664-yanic-konan-niederhauser |access-date=2 August 2023 |work=fiba.basketball}}</ref>
